confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and drink anchors rest on aggregated 2026 Munich price sources that disagree with each other, so they are bounded ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not inspected live listings. I could not confirm a November 2026 RBA observation. The FX value is the most recent AUD/USD figure I could verify on the RBA exchange-rates page, and it is dated 2026-03-20, so it may be stale. EUR-to-USD conversion for the food anchors assumes roughly 1.16 USD per EUR.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other large German and Central European cities with heavy tourism and high hotel demand, such as Frankfurt, Hamburg and Vienna. Munich is priced above the German average, especially for hotels and beer-hall or beer-garden drinks.
